## 最终结论（自然语言假设，主解：37 个百年切片 × 12 指标，相关阵主成分，未旋转）

**符号资本的三项分量（斧与剑 ZAxtSchwert、匕首 ZDolch、房屋面积 Zhausgr）在第一主轴上呈「同向、中等偏低、非主导」的取值特征，在第二主轴上则呈「同号但极不均衡、且其高分切片分居两极」的分散分布。**

**1) PC1（32.45% 方差，特征值 3.894）——同向、中等偏低。** 三项载荷为 −0.545、−0.457、−0.336（符号约定 A；约定 B 为 +0.545/+0.457/+0.336），**三者同号，彼此不抵消**，即它们在该轴上朝同一方向移动。但其量级处于 12 个指标的中下段：|载荷| 秩次 7、9、10；符号类 mean|PC1| = 0.446，低于非符号九项的 0.574，亦低于文化类 0.787（ZKeform +0.806、Zkeverz −0.767）、社会类 0.528、经济类 0.502。三项内部 PC1 极差仅 0.209，而其余九项为 1.574 → 它们内部高度一致、共同处于 PC1 的次要位置，**与铜与金（−0.725）、窖藏（−0.660）、遗迹规模（−0.474）、遗迹数量（−0.291）同侧**，与陶器器形（+0.806）、琥珀（+0.567）、斧与凿（+0.614）、镰刀（+0.260）异侧。由于 PC1 与年代高度相关（r(PC1, BCE) = +0.849，Spearman 0.865；组均值 EN +3.62 → OBA −5.81 → YBA −4.03），**PC1 主要是一条「早期金属/遗迹/陶器组合 vs 晚期组合」的时间趋势轴，符号资本只是顺着这条趋势同向偏移，而非该轴的塑造者**。

**2) PC2（16.41%，累计 48.86% < 50%）——两种口径必须并列，且结论不同。**
- **口径 (a) 载荷本身的散布：** +0.198（斧与剑，秩 11/12）、+0.283（匕首，秩 7）、+0.512（房屋面积，秩 3）；极差 0.314、sd 0.162、**三者同号、不跨越 0**。即 PC2 上并非「一半在一极、一半在另一极」，而是**同侧但强弱悬殊**：房屋面积是 PC2 上第三强的指标（与遗迹数量 +0.657、斧与凿 +0.595、铜与金 +0.491 为同一侧的强者），斧与剑几乎不进入 PC2（秩 11，仅次于 ZMW 的 0.144）。PC1+PC2 仅承载三项各自 33.7%、28.9%、37.5% 的方差（斧与剑在 PC2 上仅占其方差 3.9%，其 h²(PC1–4)=0.341 为 12 项最低）。
- **口径 (b) 高分切片在 PC2 得分轴上的位置：** 全体 37 切片 PC2 得分极 −3.411…+4.876（19 正/18 负，IQR 2.119）。斧与剑最高的 8 个切片（BCE 1900–1200）PC2 得分 −1.627…+4.876，**4 正 / 4 负，IQR 4.109（随机 8 切片均值 2.215，置换 p = 0.022），最大空隙占极差 42.7% → 分居两极**；匕首最高 8 片 6 正/2 负（IQR 3.078，p = 0.155）；房屋面积最高 8 片 6 正/2 负（IQR 2.196，p = 0.451）。**故口径 (a) 与 (b) 不一致：载荷层面三项同在 PC2 正侧、未跨零；切片层面（尤其斧与剑）高分切片确实横跨两极，且只有斧与剑的双极散布达统计显著。** 此差异如实并列，不作择一掩盖。

**3) 综合表述（可回溯到数值）：** 在百年切片 PCA 中，符号资本**不构成独立主轴**：它的全部三项在 PC1 上同号但只取中等偏低的载荷（−0.545/−0.457/−0.336，秩 7/9/10，mean|PC1| 0.446 < 0.574），说明其变动方向被 PC1 所主导的宏观（时间性）趋势裹带；在 PC2 上它既不整体成簇也不跨零，而是被拉成 0.198→0.512 的不等梯度——**房屋面积接近社会性指标一侧（PC2 秩 3），匕首居中，斧与剑基本落在 PC2 之外**；同时斧/剑的高值切片在 PC2 两极各有分布（4/4，p=0.022）。因此符号资本在本数据中表现为「**依附于 PC1 的同向次要分量 + 在 PC2 上按分量类型分化、并按时间散布于两极**」，而非一个自洽的符号资本因子。

**限定与限制（均已在产出中量化）：**
- PC1+PC2 = 48.86% < 50%（第 3 轴 13.71%），PC2 本身仅 16.41%，故关于 PC2「分布」的断言只在半个信息空间内成立；匕首一半方差（50.0%）在 PC3，ZMW 一半（51.7%）在 PC4。
- **PC 正负号由算法任意决定：本文一律以同向/异向、载荷大小与秩次表述，不主张与原文献绝对符号可比。** 约定 A、B、C 三套载荷表均已产出。
- 稳健性：符号三项「PC1 同号 + 秩 7–10 + mean|PC1| 低于非符号 + PC2 不跨零」在协方差阵 PCA（34.6%；−0.561/−0.511/−0.333）、剔除 ZMW=−3.134 切片（35.6%）、剔除首末切片（36.5%）、±50 年插值窗口（36.7%）、39 行版本（30.3%）中全部保持 → 结论不因 ZSichel 量度差异（sd 0.538、74% 为 0）或极端值而改变。
- 不确定性：Bootstrap 重抽切片（B=2000）下 PC1 载荷符号稳定 99.9/99.1/93.0%（Zhausgr 的 PC1 95% CI 上界 +0.121 跨 0），但 **PC2 载荷 CI 全部跨 0**（符号稳定性 71.7/75.3/83.8%）；切片滞后 1 阶自相关 0.59–0.79（PC1 得分 0.936），有效样本量远小于 37 → PC2 层面的结论属描述性，不宜作显著性推广。
- 旋转冲突（附录，主结论以未旋转解为准）：varimax 与 oblimin 下三项集中到**第 3 轴**（−0.435/−0.794/−0.731 与 −0.384/−0.858/−0.748），在前两轴近乎为 0；即旋转解把符号资本视为独立第三因子，与未旋转解「PC1 次要同向分量 + PC2 分化散布」的读法发生实质冲突，已如实报告。
- 仍属假设而非事实：原论文的旋转方式、切片起止、是否纳入 BCE 4300/4200 重复填充行、Z 值原始标准化窗口、是否用逐年插值序列。

payload.hypothesis: In the correlation-based, unrotated PCA of the twelve capital indicators run over the 37 hundred-year time slices (BCE 4100–500; PC1 = 32.45%, PC2 = 16.41%, PC1+PC2 = 48.86% of variance), the symbolic-capital components do NOT form their own axis: on PC1 they all load in the same direction with moderate-to-low magnitude and are therefore dragged along by the first axis rather than defining it (ZAxtSchwert/hatchet-sword -0.545, ZDolch/dagger -0.457, Zhausgr/house size -0.336; |loading| ranks 7, 9, 10 of 12; category mean |PC1| 0.446 vs 0.574 for the nine non-symbolic indicators, and 0.787 for pottery form/decoration), while PC1 itself is strongly chronological (r = +0.849 with BCE; group means +3.62 EN -> -5.81 OBA). On PC2 they are not a cluster but an uneven gradient on a single side of the axis: their loadings never change sign (range 0.198-0.512, sd 0.162, ranks 11, 7 and 3 of 12), so house size behaves like a strong PC2 variable alongside monument count (+0.657) and axes/celts (+0.595), whereas hatchets/swords are effectively absent from PC2 (rank 11, only 3.9% of their variance on PC2, communality on PC1-4 = 0.341, the lowest of the twelve). Read instead at slice level, the slices with the highest symbolic values are scattered over both poles of PC2 (8 highest hatchet/sword slices: PC2 -1.63 to +4.88, 4 positive/4 negative, IQR 4.11 vs 2.21 expected under permutation, p = 0.022; daggers 6/2, p = 0.155; house size 6/2, p = 0.451), i.e. symbolic peaks occur at both extremes rather than clustering at one pole. Because PC1+PC2 account for less than half the variance, PC2 loadings of the three indicators have bootstrap confidence intervals that include zero, and slices are strongly autocorrelated (lag-1 0.59-0.79), the PC2 pattern should be read as descriptive: symbolic capital in this series is best characterised as a secondary, internally coherent component that moves with the dominant (time-related) PC1 trend, and that splits unevenly across PC2 - house size aligning with the social/monumental side, daggers intermediate, hatchets/swords largely outside PC2 and dispersed across both its poles. Signs of the axes are arbitrary (all three sign conventions are reported), and a rotated (varimax/oblimin) solution conflicts with this by grouping all three on a third factor (-0.44/-0.79/-0.73), so the conclusion is stated only for the unrotated solution.
payload.workflow: 1) Verified data structure: capital.csv 39x15 (BCE 4300-500, comma decimals, no missing) and time_series_data.csv 3601x36 (CE -4100..-500, calBP 6050..2450); the 12 raw capital columns exist only at the 37 CE-multiple-of-100 anchor rows, which match capital.csv cell-for-cell (max abs diff 0.0); BCE 4300/4200 rows are exact duplicates of 4100; *_inter columns proved to be plain linear interpolation between anchors (hence excluded from the primary input; 100-year bins from the yearly grid = 36 bins of 100 years + one single-year bin at CE -500). 2) Main analysis: 37 slices x 12 Z-indicators, re-standardised, correlation-matrix PCA (eigen-decomposition), unrotated, loadings/scores with three sign conventions (A max-|loading| positive, B companion flip, C symbolic-mean positive); verified r(variable, score) == loading (max dev 3.5e-08). 3) Symbolic-capital focus: PC1 loading values, sign agreement, |loading| ranks and comparison with the other three capital categories; PC2 in two readings (a) spread/crossing-zero of the three loadings, (b) slice-level PC2 score distributions of the 8 highest/8 lowest slices per indicator plus a 20000-draw permutation test of their PC2 IQR. 4) Extra diagnostics: PC-time correlations, lag-1 autocorrelations, variance share per axis. 5) Sensitivity: 39-slice set, covariance-matrix PCA, removal of the ZMW = -3.134 slice, removal of edge slices, +-50y interpolation-window binning, varimax/oblimin/promax rotations (appendix), and a 2000-fold bootstrap over slices with sign anchoring. 6) Deliverables written to analysis/: loadings.csv, loadings_flipped_sign_solution.csv, loadings_display_orientation.csv, variance_explained.csv, slice_scores.csv, category_mean_loadings.csv, pc2_distribution_diagnostics.csv, pc2_spread_permutation.csv, pc_time_trend.csv, variance_share_by_axis.csv, sensitivity_models.csv, bootstrap_loadings_CI.csv, rotated_*.csv, loading_biplot_pc1_pc2.svg (loading scatter PC1 vs PC2 coloured by capital category), slice_bin_sizes.csv, run_summary.json, run_log.txt, answer.md, pca_capital.py (single reproducible script, executed).
payload.artifacts_note: analysis/pca_capital.py is the executed script; analysis/run_log.txt contains its full stdout for this run.
